card.name: Words right before ball, mat, or Salon
card.fires_on: Words in non-medical history or culture text where the next word could plausibly be 'ball' or 'mat', such as 'Paris' before 'Salon' or 'period' before 'dress'. It is often a place name or modifier in social, art or costume history.

modes.label: Place name before event
modes.description: A city name before an exhibition or fair, such as Paris Salon or New York World's Fair.

modes.label: Costume and dress setting
modes.description: Words in descriptions of period dress and riding clothes.

modes.label: Matrilineal society wording
modes.description: Words leading into 'matrilineal' in descriptions of a people's family structure.
modes.example: The Pawnee are<< a>> matrilineal people.
